title: How NFC Tags Work in 60 Seconds 📱✨ #shorts
description:
An NFC tag has no battery, yet it can talk to your phone. The phone's coil makes a magnetic field at 13.56 MHz, the tag's antenna loop catches it and turns it into power, and the chip answers by changing how much energy it draws. It only works within a few centimeters. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#nfc #contactless #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A tiny NFC tag has *no battery* at all, yet it can talk to your phone.

steps.label: Field
steps.text: Your phone's coil sends out a *magnetic field*, buzzing *13.56 million* times a second.

steps.label: Power
steps.text: Bring the tag close, and its *antenna loop* catches that field and turns it into *power*.

steps.label: Chip
steps.text: That energy wakes a tiny *chip* holding a link, a code, or a *contact card*.

steps.label: Reply
steps.text: The chip answers by *flickering* how much energy it draws, and the phone reads it as *data*.

steps.label: Range
steps.text: It only works within a few *centimeters*, so you have to *tap* on purpose.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Field, power, *data*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
